Count Non-Fatal Incident Cases by Syndrome and Hospital

Source: R/daly_cohorts.R
daly_count_non_fatal_incident_cases.Rd

Counts the non-fatal incident cases of an infectious syndrome L at each hospital h, \(I_{h,L}\): the number of distinct discharged admissions with syndrome L. This is the direct count – no CFR, no CR_L adjustment and no pathogen weighting. It is the incidence used in the YLD equations (see daly_calc_yld_associated()).

Usage

daly_count_non_fatal_incident_cases(
  data,
  syndrome_col,
  syndrome_name = NULL,
  admission_col,
  outcome_col,
  discharged_value = "Discharged",
  facility_col = NULL,
  facility_name = NULL
)

Arguments

data

Data frame with one or more rows per admission.

syndrome_col

Character. Column holding the syndrome of each admission (e.g. "chosen_syndrome").

syndrome_name

Character vector or NULL. Syndrome(s) to count (matched ignoring case and spacing). NULL counts every syndrome present.

admission_col

Character. Admission identifier column (e.g. "readmission_id"). Cases are distinct admissions, not rows or patients.

outcome_col

Character. Final outcome column.

discharged_value

Character. Value of outcome_col marking a discharged (non-fatal) admission. Default "Discharged".

facility_col

Character or NULL. Hospital column. When given, counts are returned per hospital; NULL pools all records.

facility_name

Character or NULL. Restrict to one hospital.

Value

Data frame with facility_col (when given), syndrome_col and N_NF_L (distinct discharged admissions). Hospital x syndrome combinations with no discharged admission are not listed.

Details

Each admission is counted once per syndrome, however many isolates, pathogens or antibiotic rows it has. Admissions with a missing or blank syndrome are not counted under any syndrome; a message reports how many discharged admissions that excludes. A warning is raised if an admission carries more than one syndrome, because it is then counted under each.

Examples

adm <- data.frame(
  readmission_id = c("A1", "A1", "A2", "A3", "A4", "A5"),
  hospital = c("H1", "H1", "H1", "H1", "H2", "H2"),
  syndrome = c("BSI", "BSI", "BSI", "UTI", "BSI", ""),
  outcome = c("Discharged", "Discharged", "Death", "Discharged", "Discharged", "Discharged")
)
daly_count_non_fatal_incident_cases(adm, "syndrome", NULL, "readmission_id", "outcome",
  facility_col = "hospital"
)
#> 1 discharged admission(s) have no syndrome and are not counted under any syndrome.
#> Non-fatal incident cases: 3 discharged admission(s) across 2 syndrome(s) and 2 hospital(s).
#>   hospital syndrome N_NF_L
#> 1       H1      BSI      1
#> 2       H1      UTI      1
#> 3       H2      BSI      1
